scope: Dimensionless Newtonian controlled two-body reference with independent integrated dynamics, two unscaled face-on quadrupole channels and gated interval decoding

physics.force_per_body: (rddot-r+1/r^2) e_r + 2 rdot e_theta; opposite force on opposite body

sampling.trigonometric_input: sin(2t), cos(2t) rounded to 14 decimal places then admitted as rational inputs

models: joint phase/amplitude plus two DC offsets, four coefficients

physical_controls: same repeated symbol pattern across adequate fits
unmodulated control contains no repeated frame
native signed-power identity equals exact mechanical-energy derivative
independent RK4 convergence and energy balance
decoder: physical and statistical controls must pass before decoding; transmitter truth used only after decoding

roles.native: reference force/energy/power, analytic quadrupole coefficients and sampled channels, exact carrier fits and signed residuals, exact statistical ranks
roles.python: graph/schedule construction, declared trig inputs, marker/permutation enumeration, independent Newtonian RK4 and numerical reporting
